*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /home/xeliaray/projects/LOB-Predictorium/src/regime_gating.py
+"""Regime-gated ensemble utilities for Stage 5 (W4-A / H-004)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+import math
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+import numpy as np
+import polars as pl
+from scipy.optimize import minimize
+from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
+
+from src.evaluation import weighted_pearson_correlation
+
+TargetName = Literal["t0", "t1"]
+RegimeName = Literal["low", "medium", "high"]
+
+TARGET_NAMES: tuple[TargetName, ...] = ("t0", "t1")
+REGIME_NAMES: tuple[RegimeName, ...] = ("low", "medium", "high")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RegimeThresholds:
+    """Train-time thresholds for volatility-based regime assignment."""
+
+    q33: float
+    q66: float
+    half_life: int
+    warmup_steps: int
+    proxy_column: str = "regime_proxy"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ShrinkageParameters:
+    """Adaptive shrinkage parameters for one component/target."""
+
+    enabled: bool
+    mode: str
+    tau: float
+    alpha: float
+    baseline_score: float
+    shrunk_score: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CalibrationParameters:
+    """Affine post-calibration parameters."""
+
+    scale: float
+    bias: float
+    baseline_score: float
+    calibrated_score: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TargetEnsembleArtifact:
+    """Serializable Stage 5 artifact for one target."""
+
+    target: str
+    components: tuple[str, ...]
+    shrinkage: dict[str, ShrinkageParameters]
+    regime_weights: dict[str, dict[str, float]]
+    raw_ridge_coefficients: dict[str, dict[str, float]]
+    rows_used_by_regime: dict[str, int]
+    calibration: CalibrationParameters
+    best_component: str | None
+    best_component_score: float
+    ensemble_raw_score: float
+    ensemble_calibrated_score: float
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Return a JSON-serializable representation."""
+        return asdict(self)
+
+
+def _ema_alpha(half_life: int) -> float:
+    if half_life <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("half_life must be > 0.")
+    return 1.0 - math.pow(0.5, 1.0 / float(half_life))
+
+
+def _sigmoid(values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    clipped = np.clip(values, -60.0, 60.0)
+    return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-clipped))
+
+
+def _finite_mask(*arrays: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    if not arrays:
+        raise ValueError("At least one array is required.")
+    mask = np.ones(len(arrays[0]), dtype=bool)
+    for array in arrays:
+        mask &= np.isfinite(array)
+    return mask
+
+
+def compute_sequence_regime_proxy(
+    frame: pl.DataFrame,
+    *,
+    half_life: int,
+    warmup_steps: int,
+) -> pl.DataFrame:
+    """Compute one warm-up volatility proxy per sequence via EMA(|Δmid|)."""
+    required = {"seq_ix", "step_in_seq", "p0", "p6"}
+    missing = sorted(required.difference(frame.columns))
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns for regime proxy computation: {missing}")
+    if warmup_steps <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("warmup_steps must be > 0.")
+
+    alpha = _ema_alpha(half_life)
+    warmup_last_step = warmup_steps - 1
+
+    proxy = (
+        frame.sort(["seq_ix", "step_in_seq"])
+        .with_columns(
+            [
+                ((pl.col("p0").cast(pl.Float64) + pl.col("p6").cast(pl.Float64)) / 2.0).alias("_mid_price"),
+            ]
+        )
+        .with_columns(
+            [
+                pl.col("_mid_price").diff().over("seq_ix").abs().fill_null(0.0).alias("_abs_delta_mid"),
+            ]
+        )
+        .with_columns(
+            [
+                pl.col("_abs_delta_mid")
+                .ewm_mean(alpha=alpha, adjust=False, ignore_nulls=True)
+                .over("seq_ix")
+                .alias("regime_proxy"),
+            ]
+        )
+        .filter(pl.col("step_in_seq") == warmup_last_step)
+        .select(
+            [
+                pl.col("seq_ix").cast(pl.Int32),
+                pl.col("regime_proxy").cast(pl.Float32),
+            ]
+        )
+        .sort("seq_ix")
+    )
+    return proxy
+
+
+def fit_regime_thresholds(
+    proxy_values: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    half_life: int,
+    warmup_steps: int,
+) -> RegimeThresholds:
+    """Fit Q33/Q66 thresholds on train-time sequence proxies."""
+    proxy_values = np.asarray(proxy_values, dtype=np.float64)
+    mask = np.isfinite(proxy_values)
+    if int(mask.sum()) < 3:
+        raise ValueError("At least 3 finite proxy values are required to fit thresholds.")
+
+    filtered = proxy_values[mask]
+    q33 = float(np.quantile(filtered, 1.0 / 3.0))
+    q66 = float(np.quantile(filtered, 2.0 / 3.0))
+    return RegimeThresholds(
+        q33=q33,
+        q66=q66,
+        half_life=half_life,
+        warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
+    )
+
+
+def assign_regime_labels(
+    proxy_values: np.ndarray,
+    thresholds: RegimeThresholds,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Assign low/medium/high regimes from fitted thresholds."""
+    proxy_values = np.asarray(proxy_values, dtype=np.float64)
+    regimes = np.full(proxy_values.shape[0], "unknown", dtype=object)
+    finite = np.isfinite(proxy_values)
+
+    low_mask = finite & (proxy_values < thresholds.q33)
+    mid_mask = finite & (proxy_values >= thresholds.q33) & (proxy_values < thresholds.q66)
+    high_mask = finite & (proxy_values >= thresholds.q66)
+
+    regimes[low_mask] = "low"
+    regimes[mid_mask] = "medium"
+    regimes[high_mask] = "high"
+    return regimes.astype(str)
+
+
+def apply_adaptive_shrinkage(
+    predictions: np.ndarray,
+    signal: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    tau: float,
+    alpha: float,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Apply logistic shrinkage driven by either learned vol or warm-up proxy."""
+    predictions = np.asarray(predictions, dtype=np.float64)
+    signal = np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64)
+    safe_alpha = max(float(alpha), 1e-6)
+    factor = _sigmoid((signal - float(tau)) / safe_alpha)
+    output = predictions.copy()
+    mask = _finite_mask(predictions, signal)
+    output[mask] = predictions[mask] * factor[mask]
+    return output.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+
+
+def fit_adaptive_shrinkage(
+    y_true: np.ndarray,
+    predictions: np.ndarray,
+    signal: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    mode: str,
+    min_rows: int = 128,
+    min_improvement: float = 1e-4,
+) -> ShrinkageParameters:
+    """Fit shrinkage parameters on OOF rows and keep identity if no gain appears."""
+    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
+    predictions = np.asarray(predictions, dtype=np.float64)
+    signal = np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64)
+
+    mask = _finite_mask(y_true, predictions, signal)
+    rows = int(mask.sum())
+    baseline_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[mask], predictions[mask]) if rows > 0 else 0.0
+
+    if rows < min_rows:
+        return ShrinkageParameters(
+            enabled=False,
+            mode=mode,
+            tau=0.0,
+            alpha=1.0,
+            baseline_score=baseline_score,
+            shrunk_score=baseline_score,
+        )
+
+    signal_valid = signal[mask]
+    signal_std = float(np.std(signal_valid))
+    if signal_std <= 1e-8:
+        return ShrinkageParameters(
+            enabled=False,
+            mode=mode,
+            tau=float(np.median(signal_valid)),
+            alpha=1.0,
+            baseline_score=baseline_score,
+            shrunk_score=baseline_score,
+        )
+
+    tau_candidates = np.unique(np.quantile(signal_valid, np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9)))
+    alpha_candidates = np.array([0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0], dtype=np.float64) * signal_std
+
+    best_tau = float(np.median(signal_valid))
+    best_alpha = float(alpha_candidates[2])
+    best_score = baseline_score
+
+    for tau in tau_candidates:
+        for alpha in alpha_candidates:
+            shrunk = apply_adaptive_shrinkage(predictions[mask], signal_valid, tau=float(tau), alpha=float(alpha))
+            score = weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[mask], shrunk)
+            if score > best_score:
+                best_score = score
+                best_tau = float(tau)
+                best_alpha = float(alpha)
+
+    if best_score <= baseline_score + min_improvement:
+        return ShrinkageParameters(
+            enabled=False,
+            mode=mode,
+            tau=best_tau,
+            alpha=best_alpha,
+            baseline_score=baseline_score,
+            shrunk_score=baseline_score,
+        )
+
+    return ShrinkageParameters(
+        enabled=True,
+        mode=mode,
+        tau=best_tau,
+        alpha=best_alpha,
+        baseline_score=baseline_score,
+        shrunk_score=best_score,
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_blend_weights(
+    component_names: list[str],
+    raw_weights: np.ndarray,
+) -> dict[str, float]:
+    """Convert arbitrary coefficients into robust non-negative blend weights."""
+    weights = np.asarray(raw_weights, dtype=np.float64)
+    if weights.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("raw_weights must be 1D.")
+    if len(component_names) != weights.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError("component_names and raw_weights must have the same length.")
+
+    positive = np.clip(weights, 0.0, None)
+    positive_sum = float(np.sum(positive))
+    if positive_sum <= 0.0:
+        fallback = 1.0 / float(len(component_names))
+        return {name: fallback for name in component_names}
+
+    return {
+        name: float(value / positive_sum)
+        for name, value in zip(component_names, positive, strict=True)
+    }
+
+
+def fit_ridge_blend(
+    component_names: list[str],
+    x_matrix: np.ndarray,
+    y_true: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    alpha: float,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, float], dict[str, float]]:
+    """Fit ridge coefficients, then convert them to normalized blend weights."""
+    if x_matrix.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("x_matrix must be 2D.")
+    if x_matrix.shape[0] != y_true.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError("x_matrix and y_true must have the same row count.")
+    if x_matrix.shape[1] != len(component_names):
+        raise ValueError("component_names length must match x_matrix columns.")
+
+    if x_matrix.shape[1] == 1:
+        raw = {component_names[0]: 1.0}
+        normalized = {component_names[0]: 1.0}
+        return raw, normalized
+
+    model = Ridge(alpha=alpha, fit_intercept=False)
+    model.fit(x_matrix, y_true)
+    coefficients = np.asarray(model.coef_, dtype=np.float64)
+    raw = {
+        name: float(value)
+        for name, value in zip(component_names, coefficients, strict=True)
+    }
+    normalized = normalize_blend_weights(component_names, coefficients)
+    return raw, normalized
+
+
+def blend_component_predictions(
+    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
+    regimes: np.ndarray,
+    regime_weights: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Blend component predictions with per-regime weights and row-wise fallback."""
+    regimes = np.asarray(regimes, dtype=str)
+    if not component_predictions:
+        raise ValueError("At least one component prediction array is required.")
+
+    component_names = list(component_predictions)
+    n_rows = len(regimes)
+    matrix = np.column_stack(
+        [np.asarray(component_predictions[name], dtype=np.float64) for name in component_names]
+    )
+    if matrix.shape[0] != n_rows:
+        raise ValueError("All component arrays must match the regimes length.")
+
+    blended = np.full(n_rows, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
+    for regime_name, weight_map in regime_weights.items():
+        regime_mask = regimes == regime_name
+        if not np.any(regime_mask):
+            continue
+
+        weights = np.array([float(weight_map.get(name, 0.0)) for name in component_names], dtype=np.float64)
+        regime_matrix = matrix[regime_mask]
+        valid = np.isfinite(regime_matrix)
+        effective_weights = valid * weights
+        denominator = effective_weights.sum(axis=1)
+        numerator = np.where(valid, regime_matrix * weights, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
+
+        regime_pred = np.full(regime_matrix.shape[0], np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
+        usable = denominator > 0.0
+        regime_pred[usable] = numerator[usable] / denominator[usable]
+        blended[regime_mask] = regime_pred
+
+    return blended.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+
+
+def fit_affine_calibration(
+    y_true: np.ndarray,
+    predictions: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    clip_min: float,
+    clip_max: float,
+) -> CalibrationParameters:
+    """Fit affine post-calibration on OOF predictions."""
+    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
+    predictions = np.asarray(predictions, dtype=np.float64)
+    mask = _finite_mask(y_true, predictions)
+    rows = int(mask.sum())
+    baseline_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[mask], predictions[mask]) if rows > 0 else 0.0
+
+    if rows < 32:
+        return CalibrationParameters(
+            scale=1.0,
+            bias=0.0,
+            baseline_score=baseline_score,
+            calibrated_score=baseline_score,
+        )
+
+    pred_valid = predictions[mask]
+    true_valid = y_true[mask]
+    if float(np.std(pred_valid)) <= 1e-8:
+        return CalibrationParameters(
+            scale=1.0,
+            bias=0.0,
+            baseline_score=baseline_score,
+            calibrated_score=baseline_score,
+        )
+
+    weights = np.maximum(np.abs(true_valid), 1e-8)
+    design = np.column_stack([pred_valid, np.ones_like(pred_valid)])
+    weighted_design = design * np.sqrt(weights)[:, None]
+    weighted_target = true_valid * np.sqrt(weights)
+    initial_scale, initial_bias = np.linalg.lstsq(weighted_design, weighted_target, rcond=None)[0]
+
+    def objective(params: np.ndarray) -> float:
+        scale, bias = float(params[0]), float(params[1])
+        calibrated = np.clip((pred_valid * scale) + bias, clip_min, clip_max)
+        return -weighted_pearson_correlation(true_valid, calibrated)
+
+    result = minimize(
+        objective,
+        x0=np.array([float(initial_scale), float(initial_bias)], dtype=np.float64),
+        method="L-BFGS-B",
+        bounds=[(-10.0, 10.0), (clip_min, clip_max)],
+    )
+
+    if result.success:
+        scale = float(result.x[0])
+        bias = float(result.x[1])
+        calibrated = np.clip((pred_valid * scale) + bias, clip_min, clip_max)
+        calibrated_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(true_valid, calibrated)
+        if calibrated_score > baseline_score:
+            return CalibrationParameters(
+                scale=scale,
+                bias=bias,
+                baseline_score=baseline_score,
+                calibrated_score=calibrated_score,
+            )
+
+    return CalibrationParameters(
+        scale=1.0,
+        bias=0.0,
+        baseline_score=baseline_score,
+        calibrated_score=baseline_score,
+    )
+
+
+def apply_affine_calibration(
+    predictions: np.ndarray,
+    calibration: CalibrationParameters | dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    clip_min: float,
+    clip_max: float,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Apply affine calibration with final competition clipping."""
+    if isinstance(calibration, dict):
+        scale = float(calibration.get("scale", 1.0))
+        bias = float(calibration.get("bias", 0.0))
+    else:
+        scale = float(calibration.scale)
+        bias = float(calibration.bias)
+
+    predictions = np.asarray(predictions, dtype=np.float64)
+    output = predictions.copy()
+    finite = np.isfinite(predictions)
+    output[finite] = np.clip((predictions[finite] * scale) + bias, clip_min, clip_max)
+    return output.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+
+
+def _complete_case_components(
+    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
+    row_mask: np.ndarray,
+    *,
+    min_rows: int,
+    min_component_coverage: float,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Select a stable component subset with enough complete-case rows."""
+    candidates = [
+        name
+        for name, values in component_predictions.items()
+        if float(np.mean(np.isfinite(values[row_mask]))) >= min_component_coverage
+    ]
+    if not candidates:
+        coverage_order = sorted(
+            component_predictions,
+            key=lambda name: float(np.mean(np.isfinite(component_predictions[name][row_mask]))),
+            reverse=True,
+        )
+        return coverage_order[:1]
+
+    candidates = sorted(
+        candidates,
+        key=lambda name: float(np.mean(np.isfinite(component_predictions[name][row_mask]))),
+        reverse=True,
+    )
+    while len(candidates) > 1:
+        complete_mask = row_mask.copy()
+        for name in candidates:
+            complete_mask &= np.isfinite(component_predictions[name])
+        if int(complete_mask.sum()) >= min_rows:
+            break
+        candidates.pop()
+    return candidates
+
+
+def fit_target_ensemble(
+    *,
+    target_name: str,
+    y_true: np.ndarray,
+    regimes: np.ndarray,
+    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
+    component_signals: dict[str, np.ndarray | None],
+    shrinkage_modes: dict[str, str],
+    ridge_alpha: float,
+    min_rows_per_regime: int,
+    min_component_coverage: float,
+    clip_min: float,
+    clip_max: float,
+) -> tuple[TargetEnsembleArtifact, dict[str, np.ndarray]]:
+    """Fit shrinkage, regime weights, and affine calibration for one target."""
+    if target_name not in TARGET_NAMES:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported target_name: {target_name}")
+    if not component_predictions:
+        raise ValueError(f"No component predictions available for target {target_name}.")
+
+    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
+    regimes = np.asarray(regimes, dtype=str)
+    if y_true.shape[0] != regimes.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError("y_true and regimes must have the same length.")
+
+    transformed_components: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
+    shrinkage_payload: dict[str, ShrinkageParameters] = {}
+    component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
+
+    target_mask = np.isfinite(y_true) & np.isin(regimes, np.array(REGIME_NAMES, dtype=str))
+    for component_name, values in component_predictions.items():
+        preds = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
+        if preds.shape[0] != y_true.shape[0]:
+            raise ValueError("Component prediction lengths must match y_true.")
+
+        signal = component_signals.get(component_name)
+        shrinkage_mode = shrinkage_modes.get(component_name, "none")
+        if shrinkage_mode != "none" and signal is not None:
+            params = fit_adaptive_shrinkage(
+                y_true=y_true[target_mask],
+                predictions=preds[target_mask],
+                signal=np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64)[target_mask],
+                mode=shrinkage_mode,
+            )
+            shrinkage_payload[component_name] = params
+            if params.enabled:
+                transformed = apply_adaptive_shrinkage(
+                    predictions=preds,
+                    signal=np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64),
+                    tau=params.tau,
+                    alpha=params.alpha,
+                )
+            else:
+                transformed = preds.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+        else:
+            baseline_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[target_mask], preds[target_mask])
+            params = ShrinkageParameters(
+                enabled=False,
+                mode=shrinkage_mode,
+                tau=0.0,
+                alpha=1.0,
+                baseline_score=baseline_score,
+                shrunk_score=baseline_score,
+            )
+            shrinkage_payload[component_name] = params
+            transformed = preds.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+
+        transformed_components[component_name] = np.asarray(transformed, dtype=np.float64)
+        valid_component_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(transformed_components[component_name])
+        component_scores[component_name] = (
+            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_component_mask], transformed_components[component_name][valid_component_mask])
+            if int(valid_component_mask.sum()) > 0
+            else 0.0
+        )
+
+    regime_weights: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
+    raw_ridge_coefficients: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
+    rows_used_by_regime: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for regime_name in REGIME_NAMES:
+        regime_mask = target_mask & (regimes == regime_name)
+        chosen_components = _complete_case_components(
+            transformed_components,
+            regime_mask,
+            min_rows=min_rows_per_regime,
+            min_component_coverage=min_component_coverage,
+        )
+        complete_mask = regime_mask.copy()
+        for component_name in chosen_components:
+            complete_mask &= np.isfinite(transformed_components[component_name])
+
+        rows_used = int(complete_mask.sum())
+        rows_used_by_regime[regime_name] = rows_used
+        if rows_used == 0:
+            best_component = max(component_scores, key=component_scores.get)
+            regime_weights[regime_name] = {best_component: 1.0}
+            raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = {best_component: 1.0}
+            continue
+
+        if len(chosen_components) == 1:
+            component_name = chosen_components[0]
+            regime_weights[regime_name] = {component_name: 1.0}
+            raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = {component_name: 1.0}
+            continue
+
+        matrix = np.column_stack([transformed_components[name][complete_mask] for name in chosen_components])
+        raw_map, normalized_map = fit_ridge_blend(
+            component_names=chosen_components,
+            x_matrix=matrix,
+            y_true=y_true[complete_mask],
+            alpha=ridge_alpha,
+        )
+        raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = raw_map
+        regime_weights[regime_name] = normalized_map
+
+    ensemble_raw = blend_component_predictions(
+        component_predictions=transformed_components,
+        regimes=regimes,
+        regime_weights=regime_weights,
+    )
+    calibration = fit_affine_calibration(
+        y_true=y_true,
+        predictions=ensemble_raw,
+        clip_min=clip_min,
+        clip_max=clip_max,
+    )
+    ensemble_calibrated = apply_affine_calibration(
+        predictions=ensemble_raw,
+        calibration=calibration,
+        clip_min=clip_min,
+        clip_max=clip_max,
+    )
+
+    valid_raw_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(ensemble_raw)
+    valid_cal_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(ensemble_calibrated)
+    best_component_name = max(component_scores, key=component_scores.get) if component_scores else None
+    artifact = TargetEnsembleArtifact(
+        target=target_name,
+        components=tuple(sorted(component_predictions)),
+        shrinkage=shrinkage_payload,
+        regime_weights=regime_weights,
+        raw_ridge_coefficients=raw_ridge_coefficients,
+        rows_used_by_regime=rows_used_by_regime,
+        calibration=calibration,
+        best_component=best_component_name,
+        best_component_score=float(component_scores.get(best_component_name, 0.0)) if best_component_name else 0.0,
+        ensemble_raw_score=(
+            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_raw_mask], ensemble_raw[valid_raw_mask])
+            if int(valid_raw_mask.sum()) > 0
+            else 0.0
+        ),
+        ensemble_calibrated_score=(
+            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_cal_mask], ensemble_calibrated[valid_cal_mask])
+            if int(valid_cal_mask.sum()) > 0
+            else 0.0
+        ),
+    )
+    diagnostics = {
+        **{
+            f"component__{name}": values.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+            for name, values in transformed_components.items()
+        },
+        "ensemble_raw": ensemble_raw.astype(np.float32, copy=False),
+        "ensemble_calibrated": ensemble_calibrated.astype(np.float32, copy=False),
+    }
+    return artifact, diagnostics
+
+
+def predict_target_with_artifact(
+    *,
+    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
+    regimes: np.ndarray,
+    artifact: TargetEnsembleArtifact | dict[str, Any],
+    clip_min: float,
+    clip_max: float,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Run Stage 5 inference for one target from a fitted artifact payload."""
+    if isinstance(artifact, TargetEnsembleArtifact):
+        regime_weights = artifact.regime_weights
+        calibration = artifact.calibration
+    else:
+        regime_weights = artifact["regime_weights"]
+        calibration = artifact["calibration"]
+
+    blended = blend_component_predictions(
+        component_predictions=component_predictions,
+        regimes=regimes,
+        regime_weights=regime_weights,
+    )
+    return apply_affine_calibration(
+        predictions=blended,
+        calibration=calibration,
+        clip_min=clip_min,
+        clip_max=clip_max,
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "CalibrationParameters",
+    "REGIME_NAMES",
+    "RegimeThresholds",
+    "ShrinkageParameters",
+    "TARGET_NAMES",
+    "TargetEnsembleArtifact",
+    "apply_adaptive_shrinkage",
+    "apply_affine_calibration",
+    "assign_regime_labels",
+    "blend_component_predictions",
+    "compute_sequence_regime_proxy",
+    "fit_adaptive_shrinkage",
+    "fit_affine_calibration",
+    "fit_regime_thresholds",
+    "fit_ridge_blend",
+    "fit_target_ensemble",
+    "normalize_blend_weights",
+    "predict_target_with_artifact",
+]

+"""EXP-009: W4-A regime gating and affine calibration with partial-expert support."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+import json
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import time
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import polars as pl
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+if str(REPO_ROOT) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.append(str(REPO_ROOT))
+
+from src.data import TARGET_COLUMNS, limit_frame_to_sequences, load_lob_frame  # noqa: E402
+from src.evaluation import weighted_pearson_correlation  # noqa: E402
+from src.regime_gating import (  # noqa: E402
+    REGIME_NAMES,
+    RegimeThresholds,
+    apply_adaptive_shrinkage,
+    assign_regime_labels,
+    blend_component_predictions,
+    compute_sequence_regime_proxy,
+    fit_regime_thresholds,
+    fit_target_ensemble,
+    predict_target_with_artifact,
+)
+
+from config import CONFIG, ExperimentConfig, SourceConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+JOIN_KEYS: list[str] = ["seq_ix", "step_in_seq"]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ResolvedSource:
+    """Resolved source with an actual parquet path and supported targets."""
+
+    name: str
+    path: str
+    prediction_columns: dict[str, str]
+    volatility_columns: dict[str, str]
+    shrinkage_mode: str
+    available_targets: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def prediction_column_name(source_name: str, target_name: str) -> str:
+    """Return normalized prediction column name for one component/target."""
+    return f"pred__{source_name}__{target_name}"
+
+
+def signal_column_name(source_name: str, target_name: str) -> str:
+    """Return normalized auxiliary signal column name for one component/target."""
+    return f"signal__{source_name}__{target_name}"
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse CLI arguments."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("fit", "apply"), default="fit")
+    parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=str, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--bundle-path", type=str, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--dataset-path", type=str, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--sequence-limit", type=int, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--allow-smoke-artifacts", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true")
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def setup_logging(log_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Configure file + stderr logging."""
+    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    formatter = logging.Formatter(
+        fmt="[%(asctime)s] [%(levelname)s] - %(message)s",
+        datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
+    )
+    root = logging.getLogger()
+    root.handlers.clear()
+    root.setLevel(logging.INFO)
+
+    file_handler = logging.FileHandler(log_path, encoding="utf-8")
+    file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
+    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
+    stream_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
+
+    root.addHandler(file_handler)
+    root.addHandler(stream_handler)
+
+
+def prepare_output_dir(config: ExperimentConfig, smoke: bool) -> Path:
+    """Create a timestamped run directory under experiments/EXP-009/artifacts."""
+    output_root = REPO_ROOT / config.output_dir
+    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    timestamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
+    run_name = f"{timestamp}_smoke" if smoke else timestamp
+    run_dir = output_root / run_name
+    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    return run_dir
+
+
+def save_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Write JSON with stable formatting."""
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read JSON from disk."""
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def source_config_from_dict(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> SourceConfig:
+    """Build SourceConfig from manifest JSON."""
+    return SourceConfig(
+        name=str(payload["name"]),
+        path=str(payload["path"]) if payload.get("path") is not None else None,
+        path_globs=tuple(str(item) for item in payload.get("path_globs", [])),
+        prediction_columns={str(key): str(value) for key, value in payload["prediction_columns"].items()},
+        volatility_columns={str(key): str(value) for key, value in payload.get("volatility_columns", {}).items()},
+        shrinkage_mode=str(payload.get("shrinkage_mode", "none")),
+        required=bool(payload.get("required", False)),
+    )
+
+
+def load_runtime_configuration(
+    config: ExperimentConfig,
+    args: argparse.Namespace,
+) -> tuple[str, list[SourceConfig], str | None]:
+    """Resolve dataset path, source list, and bundle path from config/manifest/CLI."""
+    if args.manifest is not None:
+        manifest_path = REPO_ROOT / args.manifest
+        manifest = load_json(manifest_path)
+        dataset_path = str(manifest.get("dataset_path", config.dataset_path))
+        sources = [source_config_from_dict(item) for item in manifest.get("sources", [])]
+        bundle_path = (
+            args.bundle_path
+            if args.bundle_path is not None
+            else str(manifest["bundle_path"]) if "bundle_path" in manifest else None
+        )
+        return dataset_path, sources, bundle_path
+
+    dataset_path = args.dataset_path or config.dataset_path
+    bundle_path = args.bundle_path
+    return dataset_path, list(config.default_sources), bundle_path
+
+
+def resolve_source_path(
+    spec: SourceConfig,
+    *,
+    allow_smoke_artifacts: bool,
+) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve one parquet source from explicit path or latest matching glob."""
+    if spec.path is not None:
+        path = REPO_ROOT / spec.path
+        return path if path.exists() else None
+
+    candidates: list[Path] = []
+    for pattern in spec.path_globs:
+        for path in REPO_ROOT.glob(pattern):
+            if not allow_smoke_artifacts and "_smoke" in path.as_posix():
+                continue
+            if path.is_file():
+                candidates.append(path)
+
+    if not candidates:
+        return None
+    return sorted(candidates)[-1]
+
+
+def build_scored_base_frame(raw_frame: pl.DataFrame, warmup_steps: int) -> pl.DataFrame:
+    """Keep scored rows and the join/target columns needed for Stage 5."""
+    frame = raw_frame.sort(JOIN_KEYS)
+    if "need_prediction" in frame.columns:
+        frame = frame.filter(pl.col("need_prediction"))
+    else:
+        frame = frame.filter(pl.col("step_in_seq") >= warmup_steps)
+
+    select_exprs: list[pl.Expr] = [
+        pl.col("seq_ix").cast(pl.Int32),
+        pl.col("step_in_seq").cast(pl.Int32),
+    ]
+    for target_name in TARGET_COLUMNS:
+        if target_name in frame.columns:
+            select_exprs.append(pl.col(target_name).cast(pl.Float32))
+    return frame.select(select_exprs).sort(JOIN_KEYS)
+
+
+def load_source_frame(spec: SourceConfig, path: Path) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, tuple[str, ...]]:
+    """Load one source parquet and normalize its prediction/signal columns."""
+    frame = pl.read_parquet(path)
+    missing_keys = [key for key in JOIN_KEYS if key not in frame.columns]
+    if missing_keys:
+        raise ValueError(f"Source {spec.name} is missing join keys: {missing_keys}")
+
+    select_exprs: list[pl.Expr] = [
+        pl.col("seq_ix").cast(pl.Int32),
+        pl.col("step_in_seq").cast(pl.Int32),
+    ]
+    available_targets: list[str] = []
+    for target_name, column_name in spec.prediction_columns.items():
+        if column_name not in frame.columns:
+            continue
+        available_targets.append(target_name)
+        select_exprs.append(pl.col(column_name).cast(pl.Float32).alias(prediction_column_name(spec.name, target_name)))
+        signal_name = spec.volatility_columns.get(target_name)
+        if signal_name is not None and signal_name in frame.columns:
+            select_exprs.append(pl.col(signal_name).cast(pl.Float32).alias(signal_column_name(spec.name, target_name)))
+
+    if not available_targets:
+        raise ValueError(f"Source {spec.name} has no usable prediction columns in {path}.")
+
+    return (
+        frame.select(select_exprs)
+        .unique(subset=JOIN_KEYS, keep="last")
+        .sort(JOIN_KEYS),
+        tuple(sorted(available_targets)),
+    )
+
+
+def build_stack_frame(
+    raw_frame: pl.DataFrame,
+    sources: list[SourceConfig],
+    config: ExperimentConfig,
+    *,
+    allow_smoke_artifacts: bool,
+) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, list[ResolvedSource]]:
+    """Join scored rows, regime proxy, and all available source predictions."""
+    stack = build_scored_base_frame(raw_frame=raw_frame, warmup_steps=config.warmup_steps)
+    regime_proxy = compute_sequence_regime_proxy(
+        raw_frame.select(["seq_ix", "step_in_seq", "p0", "p6"]),
+        half_life=config.regime_half_life,
+        warmup_steps=config.warmup_steps,
+    )
+    stack = stack.join(regime_proxy, on="seq_ix", how="left")
+
+    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource] = []
+    for spec in sources:
+        path = resolve_source_path(spec, allow_smoke_artifacts=allow_smoke_artifacts)
+        if path is None:
+            if spec.required:
+                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required source {spec.name} could not be resolved.")
+            logging.info("Skipping source %s: no matching artifact found.", spec.name)
+            continue
+
+        source_frame, available_targets = load_source_frame(spec, path)
+        stack = stack.join(source_frame, on=JOIN_KEYS, how="left")
+        resolved_sources.append(
+            ResolvedSource(
+                name=spec.name,
+                path=str(path),
+                prediction_columns=dict(spec.prediction_columns),
+                volatility_columns=dict(spec.volatility_columns),
+                shrinkage_mode=spec.shrinkage_mode,
+                available_targets=available_targets,
+            )
+        )
+        logging.info(
+            "Resolved source %s -> %s (targets=%s, shrinkage=%s)",
+            spec.name,
+            path,
+            ",".join(available_targets),
+            spec.shrinkage_mode,
+        )
+
+    if not resolved_sources:
+        raise RuntimeError("No prediction sources were resolved for EXP-009.")
+    return stack.sort(JOIN_KEYS), resolved_sources
+
+
+def collect_target_arrays(
+    stack: pl.DataFrame,
+    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource],
+    target_name: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, np.ndarray | None], dict[str, str]]:
+    """Collect per-target component predictions and auxiliary signals."""
+    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
+    component_signals: dict[str, np.ndarray | None] = {}
+    shrinkage_modes: dict[str, str] = {}
+    regime_proxy = stack.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+
+    for source in resolved_sources:
+        if target_name not in source.available_targets:
+            continue
+        pred_col = prediction_column_name(source.name, target_name)
+        if pred_col not in stack.columns:
+            continue
+
+        component_predictions[source.name] = stack.get_column(pred_col).to_numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+        if source.shrinkage_mode == "proxy":
+            component_signals[source.name] = regime_proxy
+        elif source.shrinkage_mode == "learned":
+            aux_col = signal_column_name(source.name, target_name)
+            component_signals[source.name] = (
+                stack.get_column(aux_col).to_numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+                if aux_col in stack.columns
+                else None
+            )
+        else:
+            component_signals[source.name] = None
+        shrinkage_modes[source.name] = source.shrinkage_mode
+
+    return component_predictions, component_signals, shrinkage_modes
+
+
+def fit_stage5_bundle(
+    stack: pl.DataFrame,
+    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource],
+    config: ExperimentConfig,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], pl.DataFrame, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Fit Stage 5 bundle on rows with ground truth."""
+    if "regime_proxy" not in stack.columns:
+        raise ValueError("Stack frame must contain regime_proxy.")
+
+    seq_proxy = (
+        stack.select(["seq_ix", "regime_proxy"])
+        .drop_nulls()
+        .unique(subset=["seq_ix"], keep="last")
+        .sort("seq_ix")
+    )
+    thresholds = fit_regime_thresholds(
+        seq_proxy.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy(),
+        half_life=config.regime_half_life,
+        warmup_steps=config.warmup_steps,
+    )
+    regimes = assign_regime_labels(stack.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy(), thresholds)
+    stack = stack.with_columns(pl.Series("regime_label", regimes))
+
+    prediction_columns: list[pl.Series] = []
+    target_payloads: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    metrics_by_target: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    available_targets: list[str] = []
+
+    for target_name in TARGET_COLUMNS:
+        if target_name not in stack.columns:
+            continue
+        component_predictions, component_signals, shrinkage_modes = collect_target_arrays(
+            stack=stack,
+            resolved_sources=resolved_sources,
+            target_name=target_name,
+        )
+        if not component_predictions:
+            logging.info("No components available for target %s; skipping fit.", target_name)
+            continue
+
+        artifact, diagnostics = fit_target_ensemble(
+            target_name=target_name,
+            y_true=stack.get_column(target_name).to_numpy(),
+            regimes=regimes,
+            component_predictions=component_predictions,
+            component_signals=component_signals,
+            shrinkage_modes=shrinkage_modes,
+            ridge_alpha=config.ridge_alpha,
+            min_rows_per_regime=config.min_rows_per_regime,
+            min_component_coverage=config.min_component_coverage,
+            clip_min=config.clip_min,
+            clip_max=config.clip_max,
+        )
+        target_payloads[target_name] = artifact.to_dict()
+        available_targets.append(target_name)
+        prediction_columns.extend(
+            [
+                pl.Series(f"raw_ensemble_{target_name}", diagnostics["ensemble_raw"]),
+                pl.Series(f"pred_{target_name}", diagnostics["ensemble_calibrated"]),
+            ]
+        )
+        metrics_by_target[target_name] = {
+            "available_components": list(artifact.components),
+            "best_component": artifact.best_component,
+            "best_component_score": float(artifact.best_component_score),
+            "ensemble_raw_score": float(artifact.ensemble_raw_score),
+            "ensemble_calibrated_score": float(artifact.ensemble_calibrated_score),
+            "rows_used_by_regime": artifact.rows_used_by_regime,
+        }
+
+    if not target_payloads:
+        raise RuntimeError("No targets could be fitted because no usable components were available.")
+
+    predictions = stack.select(
+        [
+            "seq_ix",
+            "step_in_seq",
+            "regime_proxy",
+            "regime_label",
+            *[target for target in TARGET_COLUMNS if target in stack.columns],
+        ]
+    ).with_columns(prediction_columns)
+
+    available_scores = [
+        metrics_by_target[target_name]["ensemble_calibrated_score"]
+        for target_name in available_targets
+    ]
+    metrics = {
+        "targets": metrics_by_target,
+        "available_targets": available_targets,
+        "weighted_pearson_mean": float(np.mean(available_scores)) if available_scores else 0.0,
+    }
+    bundle = {
+        "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
+        "dataset_path": None,
+        "regime_thresholds": asdict(thresholds),
+        "clip_bounds": {
+            "min": config.clip_min,
+            "max": config.clip_max,
+        },
+        "targets": target_payloads,
+    }
+    return bundle, predictions, metrics
+
+
+def apply_stage5_bundle(
+    stack: pl.DataFrame,
+    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource],
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    config: ExperimentConfig,
+) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Apply a fitted Stage 5 bundle to whatever components are currently available."""
+    thresholds = RegimeThresholds(**bundle["regime_thresholds"])
+    regimes = assign_regime_labels(stack.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy(), thresholds)
+    stack = stack.with_columns(pl.Series("regime_label", regimes))
+
+    prediction_columns: list[pl.Series] = []
+    metrics_by_target: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    available_targets: list[str] = []
+
+    for target_name, artifact in bundle["targets"].items():
+        component_predictions, component_signals, _ = collect_target_arrays(
+            stack=stack,
+            resolved_sources=resolved_sources,
+            target_name=target_name,
+        )
+        transformed_components: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
+        for component_name, values in component_predictions.items():
+            shrinkage = artifact["shrinkage"].get(component_name)
+            if shrinkage is None or not shrinkage.get("enabled", False):
+                transformed_components[component_name] = values
+                continue
+
+            signal = component_signals.get(component_name)
+            if signal is None:
+                transformed_components[component_name] = values
+                continue
+
+            transformed_components[component_name] = apply_adaptive_shrinkage(
+                predictions=values,
+                signal=signal,
+                tau=float(shrinkage["tau"]),
+                alpha=float(shrinkage["alpha"]),
+            )
+
+        if not transformed_components:
+            logging.info("No available components for target %s during apply; skipping.", target_name)
+            continue
+
+        raw_blend = blend_component_predictions(
+            component_predictions=transformed_components,
+            regimes=regimes,
+            regime_weights=artifact["regime_weights"],
+        )
+        final_predictions = predict_target_with_artifact(
+            component_predictions=transformed_components,
+            regimes=regimes,
+            artifact=artifact,
+            clip_min=config.clip_min,
+            clip_max=config.clip_max,
+        )
+        prediction_columns.extend(
+            [
+                pl.Series(f"raw_ensemble_{target_name}", raw_blend),
+                pl.Series(f"pred_{target_name}", final_predictions),
+            ]
+        )
+        available_targets.append(target_name)
+
+        if target_name in stack.columns:
+            target_values = stack.get_column(target_name).to_numpy()
+            raw_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(target_values, raw_blend)
+            final_score = weighted_pearson_correlation(target_values, final_predictions)
+            metrics_by_target[target_name] = {
+                "available_components": sorted(transformed_components),
+                "ensemble_raw_score": float(raw_score),
+                "ensemble_calibrated_score": float(final_score),
+            }
+
+    predictions = stack.select(
+        [
+            "seq_ix",
+            "step_in_seq",
+            "regime_proxy",
+            "regime_label",
+            *[target for target in TARGET_COLUMNS if target in stack.columns],
+        ]
+    ).with_columns(prediction_columns)
+
+    available_scores = [
+        metrics_by_target[target_name]["ensemble_calibrated_score"]
+        for target_name in available_targets
+        if target_name in metrics_by_target
+    ]
+    metrics = {
+        "targets": metrics_by_target,
+        "available_targets": available_targets,
+        "weighted_pearson_mean": float(np.mean(available_scores)) if available_scores else None,
+    }
+    return predictions, metrics
+
+
+def build_dataset_summary(
+    dataset_path: str,
+    stack: pl.DataFrame,
+    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build a compact dataset/source summary for run artifacts."""
+    return {
+        "dataset_path": dataset_path,
+        "total_sequences": int(stack.get_column("seq_ix").n_unique()),
+        "total_scored_rows": int(stack.height),
+        "resolved_sources": [
+            {
+                "name": source.name,
+                "path": source.path,
+                "shrinkage_mode": source.shrinkage_mode,
+                "available_targets": list(source.available_targets),
+            }
+            for source in resolved_sources
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def build_run_report(
+    *,
+    mode: str,
+    dataset_summary: dict[str, Any],
+    metrics: dict[str, Any],
+    runtime_seconds: float,
+) -> str:
+    """Render a compact markdown report for the run directory."""
+    lines = [
+        "# EXP-009 Run Report",
+        "",
+        "## Summary",
+        f"- Mode: `{mode}`",
+        f"- Dataset: `{dataset_summary['dataset_path']}`",
+        f"- Scored rows: `{dataset_summary['total_scored_rows']}`",
+        f"- Sequences: `{dataset_summary['total_sequences']}`",
+        f"- Resolved sources: `{len(dataset_summary['resolved_sources'])}`",
+        "",
+        "## Sources",
+    ]
+    for source in dataset_summary["resolved_sources"]:
+        targets = ", ".join(source["available_targets"])
+        lines.append(
+            f"- `{source['name']}` -> `{source['path']}` (targets={targets}, shrinkage={source['shrinkage_mode']})"
+        )
+
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## Metrics",
+            f"- Mean weighted Pearson over available targets: `{metrics['weighted_pearson_mean']}`",
+        ]
+    )
+    for target_name, target_metrics in metrics["targets"].items():
+        lines.append(
+            f"- `{target_name}`: raw={target_metrics.get('ensemble_raw_score')}, calibrated={target_metrics.get('ensemble_calibrated_score')}"
+        )
+
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## Runtime",
+            f"- End-to-end runtime: `{runtime_seconds:.3f}s`",
+        ]
+    )
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run EXP-009 fit/apply pipeline."""
+    args = parse_args()
+    dataset_path, sources, bundle_path = load_runtime_configuration(CONFIG, args)
+    allow_smoke_artifacts = bool(args.allow_smoke_artifacts or CONFIG.allow_smoke_artifacts)
+
+    run_dir = prepare_output_dir(config=CONFIG, smoke=args.smoke)
+    log_path = REPO_ROOT / CONFIG.log_dir / f"exp009_regime_gating_{run_dir.name}.log"
+    setup_logging(log_path)
+    logging.info("Starting EXP-009 in %s mode.", args.mode)
+
+    if args.smoke:
+        sequence_limit = args.sequence_limit or CONFIG.smoke_sequence_limit
+    else:
+        sequence_limit = args.sequence_limit
+
+    start_time = time.time()
+    raw_frame = load_lob_frame(REPO_ROOT / dataset_path)
+    raw_frame = limit_frame_to_sequences(frame=raw_frame, n_sequences=sequence_limit, seed=42)
+    logging.info(
+        "Loaded dataset %s: rows=%d, sequences=%d",
+        dataset_path,
+        raw_frame.height,
+        raw_frame.get_column("seq_ix").n_unique(),
+    )
+
+    stack, resolved_sources = build_stack_frame(
+        raw_frame=raw_frame,
+        sources=sources,
+        config=CONFIG,
+        allow_smoke_artifacts=allow_smoke_artifacts,
+    )
+    dataset_summary = build_dataset_summary(
+        dataset_path=dataset_path,
+        stack=stack,
+        resolved_sources=resolved_sources,
+    )
+
+    if args.mode == "fit":
+        bundle, predictions, metrics = fit_stage5_bundle(
+            stack=stack,
+            resolved_sources=resolved_sources,
+            config=CONFIG,
+        )
+        bundle["dataset_path"] = dataset_path
+        save_json(run_dir / "ensemble_bundle.json", bundle)
+    else:
+        if bundle_path is None:
+            raise ValueError("`--bundle-path` or manifest `bundle_path` is required in apply mode.")
+        bundle = load_json(REPO_ROOT / bundle_path)
+        predictions, metrics = apply_stage5_bundle(
+            stack=stack,
+            resolved_sources=resolved_sources,
+            bundle=bundle,
+            config=CONFIG,
+        )
+        save_json(run_dir / "applied_bundle_snapshot.json", bundle)
+
+    runtime_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
+
+    predictions.write_parquet(run_dir / "ensemble_predictions.parquet")
+    stack.write_parquet(run_dir / "stack_frame.parquet")
+    save_json(run_dir / "config_snapshot.json", asdict(CONFIG))
+    save_json(run_dir / "dataset_summary.json", dataset_summary)
+    save_json(run_dir / "metrics.json", metrics)
+    save_json(
+        run_dir / "train_summary.json",
+        {
+            **dataset_summary,
+            "mode": args.mode,
+            "runtime_seconds": runtime_seconds,
+            "log_path": str(log_path),
+        },
+    )
+    (run_dir / "MODEL_REPORT.md").write_text(
+        build_run_report(
+            mode=args.mode,
+            dataset_summary=dataset_summary,
+            metrics=metrics,
+            runtime_seconds=runtime_seconds,
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+    logging.info("Run completed in %.3fs", runtime_seconds)
+    logging.info("Artifacts saved to %s", run_dir)
+    print(str(run_dir))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

*** Add File: /home/xeliaray/projects/LOB-Predictorium/experiments/EXP-009/REPORT.md
+# Experiment Report: EXP-009 - Regime Gating & Calibration
+
+**Date:** 2026-02-28
+**Author:** Codex
+**Status:** In Progress
+
+---
+
+## 1. Hypothesis
+
+**ID:** H-004
+
+**Statement:** OOF-optimized regime-gated blending with adaptive shrinkage and affine calibration can beat any single available expert while remaining robust to missing components.
+
+**Expected Outcome:** Stage 5 should fit per-target/per-regime weights on whatever experts are available, then degrade gracefully when some experts are absent at inference time.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Implementation Scope
+
+- Reusable regime-gating module added in `src/regime_gating.py`.
+- `EXP-009` provides the first active Stage 5 scaffold in the repository.
+- Runtime accepts:
+  - default auto-discovered sources on `data/valid.parquet`;
+  - or an explicit manifest describing a future full OOF stack.
+
+Key properties of the implementation:
+
+- No assumption that all `6 + 1` components already exist.
+- Missing sources are skipped unless marked `required`.
+- Weights are fit only on available components, then renormalized over active components at inference time.
+- GRU shrinkage uses learned volatility heads when present; vendor/ML shrinkage uses the warm-up proxy.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Output Contract
+
+Each `EXP-009` run writes into:
+
+- `experiments/EXP-009/artifacts/<timestamp>/ensemble_bundle.json` in `fit` mode
+- `experiments/EXP-009/artifacts/<timestamp>/ensemble_predictions.parquet`
+- `experiments/EXP-009/artifacts/<timestamp>/stack_frame.parquet`
+- `experiments/EXP-009/artifacts/<timestamp>/metrics.json`
+
+---
+
+## 4. Notes
+
+- Current repository artifacts are not yet a full aligned OOF stack for all experts, so this branch focuses on the Stage 5 implementation contract and partial-expert robustness.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+import polars as pl
+
+from src.regime_gating import (
+    apply_adaptive_shrinkage,
+    assign_regime_labels,
+    blend_component_predictions,
+    compute_sequence_regime_proxy,
+    fit_adaptive_shrinkage,
+    fit_regime_thresholds,
+    fit_target_ensemble,
+    predict_target_with_artifact,
+)
+
+
+def test_compute_sequence_regime_proxy_orders_sequences_by_warmup_volatility() -> None:
+    rows: list[dict[str, float | int]] = []
+    deltas = {
+        10: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
+        20: [0.0, 0.3, 0.6],
+        30: [0.0, 1.0, 2.0],
+    }
+    for seq_ix, offsets in deltas.items():
+        for step_in_seq, offset in enumerate(offsets):
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "seq_ix": seq_ix,
+                    "step_in_seq": step_in_seq,
+                    "p0": offset,
+                    "p6": offset + 0.1,
+                }
+            )
+
+    proxy = compute_sequence_regime_proxy(
+        pl.DataFrame(rows),
+        half_life=2,
+        warmup_steps=3,
+    )
+    proxy_values = proxy.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy()
+    thresholds = fit_regime_thresholds(proxy_values, half_life=2, warmup_steps=3)
+    labels = assign_regime_labels(proxy_values, thresholds)
+
+    assert proxy.height == 3
+    assert np.all(np.diff(proxy_values) > 0.0)
+    assert labels.tolist() == ["low", "medium", "high"]
+
+

# Terminal Guidelines

- Prefer non-interactive execution. Don’t rely on pagers/editors/prompts.
  - Disable pagers per-command (don’t export globally): `PAGER=cat <cmd>`; `git --no-pager <cmd>`

- Limit output intentionally.
  - Prefer command-native limits (e.g., `git log -n N`, `journalctl -n N --no-pager`).
  - Errors/debug: prefer last lines (`tail -n N`). Help/headers: first lines (`head -n N`).
  - `rg -m N` limits matches; use `-A/-B/-C` for context.

- Pipelines may buffer output (non-TTY). If real-time matters:
  - `stdbuf -oL -eL <cmd> | ...` (if available) or `grep --line-buffered ...`
  - Python: `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` / `python -u`

- Streams must be bounded.
  - Snapshot then bounded follow: `tail -n N ...`; `journalctl -n N --no-pager`; `timeout 10s tail -F ...`
  - Use `timeout` only for observation/reading, not for side-effecting operations.

- Prefer stable output when supported: `--json`, `--porcelain`, `--quiet`, `--color=never` (don’t guess flags).

- Don’t blanket-use `set -euo pipefail`. Use strict mode only in controlled scripts with explicit handling of expected non-zero exits (grep/diff/test).

## Terminology
- **DS:** experiment-driven workflow (EDA -> baseline -> experiments -> model report).

## Memory Bank (SSOT)
- Directory name is `memory-bank/`.
- Project information is in `memory-bank/ARCHITECTURE.md`; current state is in `memory-bank/STATE.md`.
- After meaningful work write **activity report**: write to `logs/activity/<Role>/` at end of session and after non-trivial work; use 4-part structure (Metadata + Exact User Request, Task Setup, Implementation Log, Result/Conclusions (Exact Answer to User)).
- Keep main headers from templates intact; add sub-sections only when needed.

## Skills paradigm
- Skills are self-contained capability modules that define step-by-step workflows, conventions, and guardrails for specific task types.
- Proactively load the relevant skill at the start of a task — do not wait to be explicitly asked.
- Match the task to a skill using the skill's `description` ("Use when..." trigger); if it fits, load and follow it.
- A loaded skill's workflow is authoritative for its domain; follow it instead of improvising.
- For multi-phase work, chain skills sequentially (e.g., `apm-dev` → `apm-logs` → `apm-sync`).

## Subagent paradigm
- For complex DS work, decompose into independent experiment and implementation streams.
- Parallelize experiments only when data handling and output ownership are explicit.
- You can run up to 6 subagents in parallel; proactively use this when decomposing work to economize your own context window.
- Define each delegation with required metrics, output format, and verification criteria.
- Use `apm-orchestrate` for fan-out/fan-in planning and git worktree execution patterns.
- Before final integration, normalize outputs and run comparison checks.

## Restricted paths
- Do not read, write, or traverse folders marked as `old`, `irrelevant`, or `deprecated` without explicit user permission.

## Notes
- If instructions conflict, prefer the closest (most specific) AGENTS.md.

# Terminal Guidelines

- Prefer non-interactive execution. Don’t rely on pagers/editors/prompts.
  - Disable pagers per-command (don’t export globally): `PAGER=cat <cmd>`; `git --no-pager <cmd>`

- Limit output intentionally.
  - Prefer command-native limits (e.g., `git log -n N`, `journalctl -n N --no-pager`).
  - Errors/debug: prefer last lines (`tail -n N`). Help/headers: first lines (`head -n N`).
  - `rg -m N` limits matches; use `-A/-B/-C` for context.

- Pipelines may buffer output (non-TTY). If real-time matters:
  - `stdbuf -oL -eL <cmd> | ...` (if available) or `grep --line-buffered ...`
  - Python: `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` / `python -u`

- Streams must be bounded.
  - Snapshot then bounded follow: `tail -n N ...`; `journalctl -n N --no-pager`; `timeout 10s tail -F ...`
  - Use `timeout` only for observation/reading, not for side-effecting operations.

- Prefer stable output when supported: `--json`, `--porcelain`, `--quiet`, `--color=never` (don’t guess flags).

- Don’t blanket-use `set -euo pipefail`. Use strict mode only in controlled scripts with explicit handling of expected non-zero exits (grep/diff/test).

# Terminal Guidelines

- Prefer non-interactive execution. Don’t rely on pagers/editors/prompts.
  - Disable pagers per-command (don’t export globally): `PAGER=cat <cmd>`; `git --no-pager <cmd>`

- Limit output intentionally.
  - Prefer command-native limits (e.g., `git log -n N`, `journalctl -n N --no-pager`).
  - Errors/debug: prefer last lines (`tail -n N`). Help/headers: first lines (`head -n N`).
  - `rg -m N` limits matches; use `-A/-B/-C` for context.

- Pipelines may buffer output (non-TTY). If real-time matters:
  - `stdbuf -oL -eL <cmd> | ...` (if available) or `grep --line-buffered ...`
  - Python: `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` / `python -u`

- Streams must be bounded.
  - Snapshot then bounded follow: `tail -n N ...`; `journalctl -n N --no-pager`; `timeout 10s tail -F ...`
  - Use `timeout` only for observation/reading, not for side-effecting operations.

- Prefer stable output when supported: `--json`, `--porcelain`, `--quiet`, `--color=never` (don’t guess flags).

- Don’t blanket-use `set -euo pipefail`. Use strict mode only in controlled scripts with explicit handling of expected non-zero exits (grep/diff/test).

## Terminology
- **DS:** experiment-driven workflow (EDA -> baseline -> experiments -> model report).

## Memory Bank (SSOT)
- Directory name is `memory-bank/`.
- Project information is in `memory-bank/ARCHITECTURE.md`; current state is in `memory-bank/STATE.md`.
- After meaningful work write **activity report**: write to `logs/activity/<Role>/` at end of session and after non-trivial work; use 4-part structure (Metadata + Exact User Request, Task Setup, Implementation Log, Result/Conclusions (Exact Answer to User)).
- Keep main headers from templates intact; add sub-sections only when needed.

## Skills paradigm
- Skills are self-contained capability modules that define step-by-step workflows, conventions, and guardrails for specific task types.
- Proactively load the relevant skill at the start of a task — do not wait to be explicitly asked.
- Match the task to a skill using the skill's `description` ("Use when..." trigger); if it fits, load and follow it.
- A loaded skill's workflow is authoritative for its domain; follow it instead of improvising.
- For multi-phase work, chain skills sequentially (e.g., `apm-dev` → `apm-logs` → `apm-sync`).

## Subagent paradigm
- For complex DS work, decompose into independent experiment and implementation streams.
- Parallelize experiments only when data handling and output ownership are explicit.
- You can run up to 6 subagents in parallel; proactively use this when decomposing work to economize your own context window.
- Define each delegation with required metrics, output format, and verification criteria.
- Use `apm-orchestrate` for fan-out/fan-in planning and git worktree execution patterns.
- Before final integration, normalize outputs and run comparison checks.

- Do not read, write, or traverse folders marked as `old`, `irrelevant`, or `deprecated` without explicit user permission.

# Terminal Guidelines

- Prefer non-interactive execution. Don’t rely on pagers/editors/prompts.
  - Disable pagers per-command (don’t export globally): `PAGER=cat <cmd>`; `git --no-pager <cmd>`

- Limit output intentionally.
  - Prefer command-native limits (e.g., `git log -n N`, `journalctl -n N --no-pager`).
  - Errors/debug: prefer last lines (`tail -n N`). Help/headers: first lines (`head -n N`).
  - `rg -m N` limits matches; use `-A/-B/-C` for context.

- Pipelines may buffer output (non-TTY). If real-time matters:
  - `stdbuf -oL -eL <cmd> | ...` (if available) or `grep --line-buffered ...`
  - Python: `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1` / `python -u`

- Streams must be bounded.
  - Snapshot then bounded follow: `tail -n N ...`; `journalctl -n N --no-pager`; `timeout 10s tail -F ...`
  - Use `timeout` only for observation/reading, not for side-effecting operations.

- Prefer stable output when supported: `--json`, `--porcelain`, `--quiet`, `--color=never` (don’t guess flags).

- Don’t blanket-use `set -euo pipefail`. Use strict mode only in controlled scripts with explicit handling of expected non-zero exits (grep/diff/test).

Реализацию `W4-A / H-004` перенёс в [`EXP-009`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009). Добавил reusable Stage 5 слой в [`src/regime_gating.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/src\/regime_gating.py) и experiment scaffold в [`experiments/EXP-009/main_exp.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/main_exp.py) с [`config.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/config.py) и шаблоном manifest в [`manifest.example.json`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/manifest.example.json). Добавил targeted tests в [`tests/test_w4a_regime_gating.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/tests\/test_w4a_regime_gating.py); проверка прошла: `8 passed`. Это предективная задача, поскольку сами модели еще не готовы, и реализация должна учитывать, что не все модели будут готовы и должна принимать любые из имеющихся (из 6 + 1). Например, я не уверен, что успею натренировать GRU \
Для справки. Результаты сохраняй в EXP-009.

Реализацию `W4-A / H-004` перенёс в [`EXP-009`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009). Добавил reusable Stage 5 слой в [`src/regime_gating.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/src\/regime_gating.py) и experiment scaffold в [`experiments/EXP-009/main_exp.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/main_exp.py) с [`config.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/config.py) и шаблоном manifest в [`manifest.example.json`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/manifest.example.json). Контур умеет работать с неполным набором экспертов: отсутствующие sources пропускаются, веса фитятся только по доступным компонентам, а на inference blend renormalize’ится по реально активным.

Сейчас в `EXP-009` реализованы adaptive shrinkage, regime proxy `EMA(|Δmid|)` + `Q33/Q66`, ridge-based per-regime blending, affine calibration и final clip `[-6, 6]`. Добавил targeted tests в [`tests/test_w4a_regime_gating.py`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/tests\/test_w4a_regime_gating.py); проверка прошла: `8 passed`. Ещё сделал smoke run самого `EXP-009`: артефакты лежат в [`experiments/EXP-009/artifacts/2026-02-28_22-41-52_smoke`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/experiments\/EXP-009\/artifacts\/2026-02-28_22-41-52_smoke), на частичном стеке `vendor + vendor_shrunk + memory_gru_t1` получилось mean `ρ_w = 0.242462`. Это именно проверка Stage 5 contract, не финальная оценка H-004. Memory Bank синхронизирован в [`memory-bank/TASK.md`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/memory-bank\/TASK.md) и [`memory-bank/STATE.md`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/memory-bank\/STATE.md), activity report записан в [`logs/activity/Codex/Codex_2026-03-01_01-42_exp-009-stage5.md`](\/home\/xeliaray\/projects\/LOB-Predictorium\/logs\/activity\/Codex\/Codex_2026-03-01_01-42_exp-009-stage5.md).

Дальше естественные шаги:
1. Сгенерировать aligned OOF predictions для `W2-B`, `W2-C`, `W3-A` и прогнать полный fit через `EXP-009` manifest.
2. После появления полного стека запустить full inference benchmark и доделать submission packaging.

def blend_component_predictions(
    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
    regimes: np.ndarray,
    regime_weights: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Blend component predictions with per-regime weights and row-wise fallback."""
    regimes = np.asarray(regimes, dtype=str)
    if not component_predictions:
        raise ValueError("At least one component prediction array is required.")

    component_names = list(component_predictions)
    n_rows = len(regimes)
    matrix = np.column_stack(
        [np.asarray(component_predictions[name], dtype=np.float64) for name in component_names]
    )
    if matrix.shape[0] != n_rows:
        raise ValueError("All component arrays must match the regimes length.")

    blended = np.full(n_rows, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    for regime_name, weight_map in regime_weights.items():
        regime_mask = regimes == regime_name
        if not np.any(regime_mask):
            continue

        weights = np.array([float(weight_map.get(name, 0.0)) for name in component_names], dtype=np.float64)

def fit_target_ensemble(
    *,
    target_name: str,
    y_true: np.ndarray,
    regimes: np.ndarray,
    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray],
    component_signals: dict[str, np.ndarray | None],
    shrinkage_modes: dict[str, str],
    ridge_alpha: float,
    min_rows_per_regime: int,
    min_component_coverage: float,
    clip_min: float,
    clip_max: float,
) -> tuple[TargetEnsembleArtifact, dict[str, np.ndarray]]:
    """Fit shrinkage, regime weights, and affine calibration for one target."""
    if target_name not in TARGET_NAMES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported target_name: {target_name}")
    if not component_predictions:
        raise ValueError(f"No component predictions available for target {target_name}.")

    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
    regimes = np.asarray(regimes, dtype=str)
    if y_true.shape[0] != regimes.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("y_true and regimes must have the same length.")

    transformed_components: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
    shrinkage_payload: dict[str, ShrinkageParameters] = {}
    component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}

    target_mask = np.isfinite(y_true) & np.isin(regimes, np.array(REGIME_NAMES, dtype=str))
    for component_name, values in component_predictions.items():
        preds = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
        if preds.shape[0] != y_true.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError("Component prediction lengths must match y_true.")

        signal = component_signals.get(component_name)
        shrinkage_mode = shrinkage_modes.get(component_name, "none")
        if shrinkage_mode != "none" and signal is not None:
            params = fit_adaptive_shrinkage(
                y_true=y_true[target_mask],
                predictions=preds[target_mask],
                signal=np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64)[target_mask],
                mode=shrinkage_mode,
            )
            shrinkage_payload[component_name] = params
            if params.enabled:
                transformed = apply_adaptive_shrinkage(
                    predictions=preds,
                    signal=np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64),
                    tau=params.tau,
                    alpha=params.alpha,
                )
            else:
                transformed = preds.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
        else:
            baseline_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(preds)
            baseline_score = (
                weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[baseline_mask], preds[baseline_mask])
                if int(baseline_mask.sum()) > 0
                else 0.0
            )
            params = ShrinkageParameters(
                enabled=False,
                mode=shrinkage_mode,
                tau=0.0,
                alpha=1.0,
                baseline_score=baseline_score,
                shrunk_score=baseline_score,
            )
            shrinkage_payload[component_name] = params
            transformed = preds.astype(np.float32, copy=False)

        transformed_components[component_name] = np.asarray(transformed, dtype=np.float64)
        valid_component_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(transformed_components[component_name])
        component_scores[component_name] = (
            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_component_mask], transformed_components[component_name][valid_component_mask])
            if int(valid_component_mask.sum()) > 0
            else 0.0
        )

    regime_weights: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    raw_ridge_coefficients: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    rows_used_by_regime: dict[str, int] = {}
    for regime_name in REGIME_NAMES:
        regime_mask = target_mask & (regimes == regime_name)
        chosen_components = _complete_case_components(
            transformed_components,
            regime_mask,
            min_rows=min_rows_per_regime,
            min_component_coverage=min_component_coverage,
        )
        complete_mask = regime_mask.copy()
        for component_name in chosen_components:
            complete_mask &= np.isfinite(transformed_components[component_name])

        rows_used = int(complete_mask.sum())
        rows_used_by_regime[regime_name] = rows_used
        if rows_used == 0:
            best_component = max(component_scores, key=component_scores.get)
            regime_weights[regime_name] = {best_component: 1.0}
            raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = {best_component: 1.0}
            continue

        if len(chosen_components) == 1:
            component_name = chosen_components[0]
            regime_weights[regime_name] = {component_name: 1.0}
            raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = {component_name: 1.0}
            continue

        matrix = np.column_stack([transformed_components[name][complete_mask] for name in chosen_components])
        raw_map, normalized_map = fit_ridge_blend(
            component_names=chosen_components,
            x_matrix=matrix,
            y_true=y_true[complete_mask],
            alpha=ridge_alpha,
        )
        raw_ridge_coefficients[regime_name] = raw_map
        regime_weights[regime_name] = normalized_map

    ensemble_raw = blend_component_predictions(
        component_predictions=transformed_components,
        regimes=regimes,
        regime_weights=regime_weights,
    )
    calibration = fit_affine_calibration(
        y_true=y_true,
        predictions=ensemble_raw,
        clip_min=clip_min,
        clip_max=clip_max,
    )
    ensemble_calibrated = apply_affine_calibration(
        predictions=ensemble_raw,
        calibration=calibration,
        clip_min=clip_min,
        clip_max=clip_max,
    )

    valid_raw_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(ensemble_raw)
    valid_cal_mask = target_mask & np.isfinite(ensemble_calibrated)
    best_component_name = max(component_scores, key=component_scores.get) if component_scores else None
    artifact = TargetEnsembleArtifact(
        target=target_name,
        components=tuple(sorted(component_predictions)),
        shrinkage=shrinkage_payload,
        regime_weights=regime_weights,
        raw_ridge_coefficients=raw_ridge_coefficients,
        rows_used_by_regime=rows_used_by_regime,
        calibration=calibration,
        best_component=best_component_name,
        best_component_score=float(component_scores.get(best_component_name, 0.0)) if best_component_name else 0.0,
        ensemble_raw_score=(
            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_raw_mask], ensemble_raw[valid_raw_mask])
            if int(valid_raw_mask.sum()) > 0
            else 0.0
        ),
        ensemble_calibrated_score=(
            weighted_pearson_correlation(y_true[valid_cal_mask], ensemble_calibrated[valid_cal_mask])
            if int(valid_cal_mask.sum()) > 0
            else 0.0
        ),

        **{

        },
        "ensemble_raw": ensemble_raw.astype(np.float32, copy=False),
        "ensemble_calibrated": ensemble_calibrated.astype(np.float32, copy=False),

def build_stack_frame(
    raw_frame: pl.DataFrame,
    sources: list[SourceConfig],
    config: ExperimentConfig,
    *,
    allow_smoke_artifacts: bool,
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, list[ResolvedSource]]:
    """Join scored rows, regime proxy, and all available source predictions."""
    stack = build_scored_base_frame(raw_frame=raw_frame, warmup_steps=config.warmup_steps)
    regime_proxy = compute_sequence_regime_proxy(
        raw_frame.select(["seq_ix", "step_in_seq", "p0", "p6"]),
        half_life=config.regime_half_life,
        warmup_steps=config.warmup_steps,
    )
    stack = stack.join(regime_proxy, on="seq_ix", how="left", coalesce=True)

    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource] = []
    for spec in sources:
        path = resolve_source_path(spec, allow_smoke_artifacts=allow_smoke_artifacts)
        if path is None:
            if spec.required:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required source {spec.name} could not be resolved.")
            logging.info("Skipping source %s: no matching artifact found.", spec.name)
            continue

        try:
            source_frame, available_targets = load_source_frame(spec, path)
        except ValueError as exc:
            if spec.required:
                raise
            logging.info("Skipping source %s: %s", spec.name, exc)
            continue

        stack = stack.join(source_frame, on=JOIN_KEYS, how="left", coalesce=True)
        resolved_sources.append(
            ResolvedSource(
                name=spec.name,
                path=str(path),
                prediction_columns=dict(spec.prediction_columns),
                volatility_columns=dict(spec.volatility_columns),
                shrinkage_mode=spec.shrinkage_mode,
                available_targets=available_targets,
            )
        )
        logging.info(
            "Resolved source %s -> %s (targets=%s, shrinkage=%s)",
            spec.name,
            path,
            ",".join(available_targets),
            spec.shrinkage_mode,
        )

    if not resolved_sources:
        raise RuntimeError("No prediction sources were resolved for EXP-009.")
    return stack.sort(JOIN_KEYS), resolved_sources


def collect_target_arrays(
    stack: pl.DataFrame,
    resolved_sources: list[ResolvedSource],
    target_name: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, np.ndarray | None], dict[str, str]]:
    """Collect per-target component predictions and auxiliary signals."""
    component_predictions: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
    component_signals: dict[str, np.ndarray | None] = {}
    shrinkage_modes: dict[str, str] = {}
    regime_proxy = stack.get_column("regime_proxy").to_numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)

    for source in resolved_sources:
        if target_name not in source.available_targets:
            continue
        pred_col = prediction_column_name(source.name, target_name)
        if pred_col not in stack.columns:
            continue

        component_predictions[source.name] = stack.get_column(pred_col).to_numpy().astype(np.float32, copy=False)
        if source.shrinkage_mode == "proxy":
            component_signals[source.name] = regime_proxy
        elif source.shrinkage_mode == "learned":
            aux_col = signal_column_name(source.name, target_name)
            component_signals[source.name] = (
